judgments.rewrite_hint: 「Through Muse, trained human contract workers made some calls and completed the exchanges with users.」の “with users” を、電話をかけた相手を指す表現に狭める。Ledger fact_id: MUSE-HC-006.

「the user’s sensitive information might be shared with contract workers at a call center. One helper meant one more person handling private data.」後半の、実際に扱ったという断定を、情報共有が起こり得るという懸念・可能性に限定する。Ledger fact_id: MUSE-HC-010.
